acceptance.grader_confidentiality: FAIL if any of three synthetic canaries is visible to code in the grader container namespace
acceptance.host_containment_and_container_limits: PASS only when all three candidate probes deny host-canary access and egress and observed effective limits match the lock
acceptance.lifecycle_cleanup: PASS only when normal, timeout, cancellation, and output-overflow runs leave no newly created managed container
acceptance.live_candidate_execution: must remain BLOCKED regardless of A-C because grader confidentiality and hostile-kernel escape are not proven

claim_limit: E0 runtime-boundary observations only; not a security certification, candidate escape guarantee, trusted hidden grader, agent capability, or model-learning result

probes.grader_visibility: use DockerRepositoryEvaluator's exact mount/limit builder with only the worker entrypoint replaced by a harmless read of a random synthetic canary under /grader; visibility is a confidentiality FAIL
probes.host_canary: synthetic file placed in the shared host path but outside candidate bind mount; read and write attempts must fail
lifecycle: wall-time timeout while a child sleeps
controller cancellation while a child sleeps
probes.network: socket connect to RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 address 203.0.113.1:65000 must fail and container must have no default route
probes.process_limit: spawn workers until EAGAIN at configured pids limit; all spawned workers are killed before probe exit
probes.resource_limits: observe cgroup memory.max, cpu.max and pids.max plus live docker inspect values

stop_conditions: refuse to run unless the named Colima VM reports macOS Virtualization.Framework, Docker runtime, and seccomp enabled
use only synthetic canaries and a digest-pinned preloaded public Python image; never mount operator secrets or held-out data
abort if the output directory already exists or the pinned image digest is unavailable locally
do not execute a model, agent, repository issue patch, or real task grader
